attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of Alvin I. Gilmore & Associates
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Collections Lawyers in Cleveland, OH
attorneys.bio:
I have been a collection attorney for several years. I started my career while attending law school working as a collector in the Cleveland area for the public sector. After law school I worked as a chief attorney for the Veterans Administration investigating claims and determining validity. In addition I worked for other Collection and Bankruptcy firms in Northeast Ohio and opened my own practice over 25 years ago.

Our many years of experience, knowledge and proven techniques in the collection field have afforded my firm great success. Every claim is thoroughly reviewed and investigated insuring all facets are utilized when determining the best course of action to pursue each claim. We accept claims for varied amounts and treat each one individually and with equal importance.

Our firm has recovered many accounts for my current and newly acquired clients. Our firm looks forward to assisting you with your collection needs. You may contact us to place your claim(s) via facsimile, by email or through the U.S. Mail.

Contact us today via phone or email to discuss how we can assist you.

attorneys.name: James S. Ginocchio
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Litigation Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Jim’ s entire career has been focused on litigation. He started as an Assistant Prosecuting Attorney with the Hamilton County Prosecutor’s Office, trying all manner of criminal cases from minor misdemeanors to high level felonies in all trial courts in Hamilton County. After 10 years of criminal litigation, he transitioned to the office’s civil division. There, he represented Hamilton County offices and elected officials in various litigation including construction litigation, civil rights claims, contract disputes, regulatory enforcement, workers compensation defense, environmental regulations, nuisance abatement, and personal injury defense in state and federal courts.

Since 2012, Jim has maintained a family law practice helping parents navigate difficult transitions. He has tried countless custody trials and property disputes in both Domestic Relations and Juvenile Courts throughout Southwest Ohio. Since joining Lindhorst & Dreidame, Jim has focused his practice on business litigation and medical malpractice matters, in addition to maintaining his family law practice.

attorneys.name: Mark Edward Godbey
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Mark Edward Godbey is a native of Cincinnati, Ohio and owner of Mark Godbey & Associates. Our law firm is a full service, general practice firm, serving clients in Southwestern Ohio and Northern Kentucky. Our five attorneys have over 70 years of combined experience. While each attorney focuses on one or two specific areas of practice, our office as a whole can provide a variety of legal services to our clients.

Since 1993, we have been representing and advising clients in the areas of auto accidents and other types of personal injury claims, divorce and other areas of family law, consumer bankruptcy and debt reorganization, criminal and traffic defense, estate planning and probate, immigration, and small business representation.

We pride ourselves in providing high quality, cost effective legal representation to individuals and small businesses, while also giving the personal attention and service that each client deserves. Our mission is to advocate for our clients with excellence and integrity. We recognize that our clients rely upon our advice and expertise in the courtroom, but also deserve our attention and responsiveness.

Our attorneys and staff are committed to the pursuit of excellence in the courtroom, to communicate effectively with our clients, and to demonstrate the strictest personal and professional ethics. We strive daily to establish relationships with our clients that will endure.

attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Juliette Gaffney Dame
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Lebanon, OH
attorneys.bio:
Shantya is a devoted family law attorney, dedicated to guiding clients through life's most challenging moments. Her interest in family law began in law school, where she took a family law course and interned with the Domestic Violence and Civil Protection Order Clinic, representing clients in civil protection and stalking orders.

After being born and raised in Dayton, Ohio, Shantya proudly calls herself a double Bearcat—earning her B.S. in Criminal Justice from the University of Cincinnati in 2019 and graduating from the University of Cincinnati College of Law in 2023.

Known for her honest and empathetic approach, Shantya is especially skilled at remaining calm under pressure, ensuring that her clients feel supported and understood throughout the legal process. She genuinely cares about her clients' well-being and works tirelessly to protect their interests.

Prior to joining the firm, she worked with the Ohio Innocence Project, advocating for the wrongfully convicted. She also gained valuable experience interning at the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit and the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Kentucky. She looks forward to continuing to grow her professional expertise in family law and making a meaningful difference in the lives of her clients.

She brings her strength from the Ohio Innocence Project to the areas of domestic relations and juvenile law where she now guides clients throughout southwest Ohio through divorce, dissolution and custody matters.

attorneys.firm_name: Martin E. Goff, Attorney at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Toledo, OH
attorneys.bio:
A note from Martin...

With 28 years of experience representing clients on a wide variety of cases, both civil and criminal, I have the knowledge and the experience to assist my clients with any legal challenge they face. I take pride in being here for my clients so they have an attorney they can trust, no matter what legal situation they find themselves in.

One of my primary goals is to provide legal services in an efficient and useful manner. I want to give my clients the information and advise they need, when they need it. I always keep clients informed on the status of their case and the issues yet to be resolved. Staying in communication with my clients and promptly responding to inquiries are my best shield against unwelcome surprises.

When my clients are embroiled in a contentious civil or criminal manner, I aggressively advocate to protect their rights and interests. When your property or your freedom is on the line, you need an attorney who will use every fact and legal advantage to fight for you. I work tirelessly to safeguard your rights, interests, and goals.

attorneys.name: Jeffrey S. Goldenberg
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Jeff’s practice includes class action and complex civil litigation with an emphasis on consumer protection. He practices in the following areas: consumer fraud and defective products, insurance coverage (including long-term care insurance), personal privacy and data breach, antitrust, personal injury, toxic torts, pet food contamination, and pension litigation.

Jeff served as lead and/or co-counsel in numerous successful multi-million dollar complex civil cases throughout the United States, including: (1) Ford F-150 Spark Plug and 5.4 Liter Engine Defect Litigation, (2) Enzyte Consumer Fraud Litigation, (3) Mercedes Diesel Emissions Fraud Litigation, (4) Continental Casualty Long Term Care Insurance Litigation, (5) VA Data Theft Litigation, (6) City of Cincinnati Pension Litigation, (7) Ford and Nissan Throttle Body Defect Litigation, (8) Navy Federal Credit Union TCPA Litigation, (9) Deloitte Data Breach Litigation, (10) Auto Parts Antitrust Litigation, (11) LeafFilter Product Defect Litigation, and (12) Acura RDX Infotainment Litigation. Jeff presently serves as lead or co-counsel on: (1) Progress Software Data Breach Litigation, (2) Volkswagen Atlas Wiring Harness Defect Litigation, (3) CNA Insurance Group Policy Premium Increase Litigation, (4) Norfolk Southern East Palestine Train Derailment Litigation, (5) STRB Pension Litigation, (6) CDK Global Data Security Consumer Litigation, (7) Infosys McCamish Systems Data Breach Litigation, (8) Kia & Hyundai Vehicle Theft Litigation, (9) Mid-America Pet Food Contamination Litigation, (10) Christ Hospital Pixel Litigation, and (11) Acura RDX Rear Windshield Defect Litigation.

Jeff also served as Special Counsel representing the State of Ohio against the Tobacco industry and was part of the litigation team that achieved an unprecedented $9.86 billion settlement for Ohio taxpayers. He also served as lead counsel on the In re Consolidated Mortgage Satisfaction Cases involving twenty separate class actions that resulted in a significant Ohio Supreme Court decision defining key aspects of Ohio class action law and affirming the trial court's class certification.

Jeff earned three degrees from Indiana University: a Bachelor of Arts in Biology in 1988 (Phi Beta Kappa); a Master’s of Science in Environmental Science in 1994; and his Juris Doctor in 1994. Jeff has practiced in all levels of Ohio trial and appellate courts as well as other courts across the nation, and is admitted to practice in the State of Ohio and multiple federal district and appellate courts listed below. Jeff is a member of the American Association for Justice, the Ohio State Bar Association, and the Cincinnati Bar Association.

attorneys.name: David A. Goldstein Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: David A. Goldstein Co., L.P.A., Attorneys at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in Columbus, OH
attorneys.bio:
David A. Goldstein is principal and founder of David A. Goldstein Co., L.P.A., a law firm located in Columbus, Ohio. The law firm has two associates and six staff members. The firm concentrates its practice in insurance defense, general litigation and collections for the State of Ohio.

David has been a practicing attorney for over 18 years, focusing on civil litigation for the past 15 years. The primary concentration of his litigation practice is Insurance Defense . His clients include Safe Auto Insurance Company, Century Surety Insurance Company, Infinity Insurance Group, Dairyland Insurance Company, & Homesite Insurance Company. He has been lead counsel in over 50 jury trials involving automobile accidents, slip and fall cases, catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, and bad faith allegations.

David is a frequent lecturer and instructor for continuing education seminars in the areas of trial advocacy, evidence, ethics, and professionalism. David has also prepared and conducted training involving claims handling, investigation of claims, investigation of fraudulent claims, and bad faith.

David was an Assistant Prosecutor for Franklin County with a concentration in white collar crime prosecution. During his time with the Franklin County Prosecutor's office, David worked with the Ohio Department of Insurance in prosecuting fraudulent insurance claims.

David received his Business Administration degree from The Ohio State University in 1991, concentrating his business efforts in Accounting. He graduated from Capital University Law School obtaining his Juris Doctorate in 1994.

David is AV Preeminent rated, the highest rating achievable in his profession by his peers. David is licensed to practice in the state of Ohio, the Northern and Southern Federal District Courts and Unites States Court of Appeals. David belongs to several organizations including The Ohio State Bar Association, Columbus Bar Association, and The Ohio Association of Civil Trial Attorneys. David belongs to several organizations including The Ohio State Bar Association, Columbus Bar Association, Kentucky Bar Association, and The Ohio Association of Civil Trial Attorneys. He is a member of a several boards including The City Club of Columbus and Parker Lee Foundation.

attorneys.name: Michael D. Goldstein Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Wrongful Death Lawyers in Beachwood, OH
attorneys.bio:
A Northeast Ohio native, Michael graduated from The Ohio State University in 1999, and completed his Juris Doctorate at the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 2002. Returning to Cleveland to form Goldstein & Goldstein, Michael focuses his practice on handling complex litigation, representing people and families of those injured in accidents, victims of sexual and physical abuse, nursing home neglect, medical malpractice, and wrongful death claims. Michael has become an accomplished Trial Attorney, and obtained numerous large verdicts and settlements for his clients, including million and multi-million dollar results in wrongful death and medical malpractice claims. Michael takes pride in tackling difficult legal challenges on behalf of his clients, and continues to fight every day against insurance companies and corporations, in an effort to recover fair compensation on behalf of people who have been injured. Michael's recent experience includes handling cases for victims of physical and sexual abuse, medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, wrongful death, insurance bad faith and trucking and motor vehicle crashes.

Michael is a board certified trial lawyer, obtaining his certification in civil trial advocacy by the National Board of Trial Advocacy. Michael has been recognized by Super Lawyers Magazine as one of the top attorneys in Ohio every year since 2016. Michael has also been selected as a Top 100 Trial Lawyer by the National Trial Lawyers every year since 2015, as a Top 10 Nursing Home Lawyer, and every year since 2016, Michael has been selected for membership in the Nations Top One Percent by the National Association of Distinguished Counsel, representing a selection of the top one percent of attorneys in the United States based on standards of legal excellence.

Michael loves competition and being active. When he’s not practicing law, Michael enjoys coaching his sons’ sports teams, travelling with his family, playing softball, and competing in marathons and triathlons.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Beachwood, OH
attorneys.bio:
William M. Goldstein (1939 - 2022) practiced law in Cleveland from 1969 until his retirement in 2017. Those years of experience provided him with the ability to solve a wide range of legal problems, and assist each client on a personalized basis, for almost any legal situation which may arise. Over the years, he successfully helped hundreds of clients with issues including divorce, probate, personal injury, workers compensation, small business matters, consumer fraud and business legal and management issues.

William's success has always been driven by strong relationships he has developed with both clients and attorneys throughout the legal community. Until the time of his passing, William remained involved with the firm and his previous clients, and acted as an advisor to the firm, always willing to share his wealth of knowledge.

William is deeply missed by his family, his firm, and generations of clients who he assisted and treated like family over the years.

attorneys.name: James H. Gordon Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: National Trial Practice Lawyers in Columbus, OH
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Gordon is a trial lawyer representing individuals and corporations, including Fortune 50 companies. His cases often involve wrongful death or catastrophic personal injuries, ranging from severe burns or loss of limb to traumatic brain injury (TBI). While based in Columbus, Ohio, Mr. Gordon tries cases throughout the country in both state and Federal courts in matters civil and criminal.

Unlike many “litigators” who engage in and charge for case activities without clearly defined exit strategies, Mr. Gordon employs backward planning to each and every one of his cases. He pinpoints the law upon which a jury will most likely be instructed at trial, and develops compelling facts that can be presented clearly and effectively before that jury, putting his clients in their optimal position to obtain favorable outcomes.

Prior to joining Ansa Assuncao, Mr. Gordon was with the global law firm DLA Piper US LLP. He built the foundation for his trial practice in the United States Marine Corps, where he served as a Marine Judge Advocate and a Special Assistant to the United States Attorney. While on active duty, Mr. Gordon led international missions that included the training of Iraqi Special Tribunal (IST) investigators in anticipation of the trials of Saddam Hussein and other Baath Party officials and the development of criminal procedure and disciplinary codes with the Afghan National Army.

Mr. Gordon enjoys working with experienced and aspiring trial lawyers in the development of their craft. He has served as an adjunct professor of trial practice at Villanova University's School of Law, an evidence instructor at the Naval Justice School, and a guest lecturer for the most senior uniformed trial attorneys in all of the services. He has conducted multiple moot court events, including competitions with The United States Military Academy at West Point, The United States Naval Academy, and students at The University of San Diego and the Roger Williams University School of Law.

attorneys.name: Gerhardt "Gage" Gosnell II
attorneys.practice_type: General Litigation Lawyers in Columbus, OH
attorneys.bio:
Gage has represented clients in a variety of matters in state and federal trial courts throughout Ohio, the Ohio Courts of Appeal, the Ohio Supreme Court, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, and the United States Supreme Court. Gage has a practice focused on complex commercial and tort litigation, with an emphasis in appellate advocacy.

In 2012, Gage was victorious in the Ohio Supreme Court on behalf of the Knox County Commissioners and the County Risk Sharing Authority, in a case in which the Ohio Supreme Court held that the Ohio Constitution allows the use of motor vehicle and gas tax (MVGT) revenues to pay the portion of the county's insurance premium covering the county engineer's highway department. The Court's unanimous (7-0) decision reversed the Court of Appeals and effectively overruled the results of a prior 2006 decision. In that same year, Gage was part of the legal team that won a hard-fought appeal in the Sixth Circuit U.S. Court of Appeals in favor of Columbus-based shoe retailer, DSW Inc -- a victory that resulted in an award of over $7.1 million against National Union Fire Insurance Company of Pittsburgh, PA. 2009, Gage was the lead counsel representing the Ohio Grocers Association in the Ohio Supreme Court in a constitutional challenge to Ohio's commercial activities tax, a case Columbus Business First called "one of [the court's] most important cases of the year." In 2010, Gage represented retail natural gas suppliers in the United States Supreme Court in a constitutional challenge to Ohio's taxation of natural gas sales. Gage has represented numerous clients in amicus briefs to the Ohio Supreme Court including three former Ohio attorneys general in an amicus brief to the Ohio Supreme Court in 2010 relating to the power and authority of the attorney general to represent the state of Ohio in matters pending before the courts. Gage has represented plaintiffs in high-profile defamation cases at both the trial and appellate level.

In 2012, Gage was designated a Best Lawyers® for Appellate Advocacy, and in 2019, was awarded Appellate Practice "Lawyer of the Year" for Columbus, Ohio. Prior to joining Arnold & Clifford in May 2011, Gage was a partner at the Columbus law firm of Chester Willcox & Saxbe LLP in their litigation section. He began his legal career in 1995, when he joined the Columbus office of Jones Day. Gage served four years as a judicial law clerk for Judge Cynthia Lazarus on the Ohio Tenth District Court of Appeals.

attorneys.name: Sarah Otte Graber
attorneys.practice_type: Trademarks Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Sarah Otte Graber is a Partner with Wood, Herron & Evans and is involved in all areas of trademark prosecution and litigation, copyright law and unfair competition. She assists clients in determining proactive and effective measures to develop and protect their intellectual property portfolios.

Sarah has considerable experience in U.S. and foreign trademark matters and has significant experience in trademark clearance, monitoring, and enforcement of trademark rights through litigations, oppositions and other proceedings. Additionally, she has experience with mergers and acquisitions, ensuring that her clients' intellectual property is successfully transferred throughout the world. Prior to joining Wood, Herron and Evans, Sarah was a Trademark Examining Attorney at the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office where she reviewed numerous trademark applications for registration eligibility and advised attorneys and pro se applicants on a variety of prosecution matters. Sarah takes pride in successfully obtaining registrations, both U.S. and international, for her clients where others have not been successful.

Sarah has served as a member of the Executive Committee of Wood Herron & Evans, which manages the firm’s operations. Sarah is currently a member of the Executive Committee of Wood Herron & Evans, which manages the firm's operations. When not practicing law, Sarah enjoys gardening, painting and spending time outdoors with her family.

attorneys.name: Nicholas D. Graman
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Lebanon, OH
attorneys.bio:
Nick Graman is an Ohio native who graduated cum laude from Xavier University. Nick graduated from the University of Cincinnati College of Law where he served as the business manager for the University of Cincinnati Law Review. He also clerked for Ohio's Twelfth District Court of Appeals while in school.

Mr. Graman concentrates on criminal defense. He has an extensive criminal defense practice in Warren County, Hamilton County, Clermont County, and Butler County. He is trained and certified in Standardized Field Sobriety Testing and prepared to aggressively defend DUI charges. In addition to DUI cases, Mr. Graman handles all felony and misdemeanor charges, including domestic violence, theft, and drug offenses.

Mr. Graman has a strong record of success in defending criminal cases. He has worked out various misdemeanor pleas deals for clients who were facing lengthy prison sentences and felony convictions, including clients who were facing first and second degree felony charges. He is also prepared to litigate if a favorable plea deal is not reached. For example, Mr. Graman has received a not guilty verdict in a jury trial for a man facing 8 years in prison when the last plea offered by the prosecution was a 4 year prison term.

Mr. Graman also has an extensive and successful appellate practice. He has argued in several appellate courts across Ohio as well as multiple times before the Supreme Court of Ohio. As a result of Mr. Graman's success in the Ohio Supreme Court, defendants who successfully complete a treatment program are now eligible to have their records immediately sealed.

Based on his experience and success, Mr. Graman has been selected numerous times to the Ohio Super Lawyers Rising Stars list and has been named a Top 100 Trial Lawyer by The National Trial Lawyers. Mr. Graman has also been a speaker at Ohio seminars on criminal defense topics and has been published in the Ohio Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers magazine.

attorneys.name: Melissa A. Graham
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law/Domestic Relations Lawyers in Green, OH
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Graham-Hurd focuses on Family Law, a term that includes: termination of marriage cases, whether it is Divorce or Dissolution; post-decree matters that arise after the Decree is issued, whether they are enforcement of the Decree by contempt actions, or Motions to change the Decree regarding parenting and support issues; problems of people who never married but had children and property together; antenuptial and cohabitation agreements; visitation and custody to third parties such as grandparents; mediation of family law issues; powers of attorney, healthcare and financial; and Wills and Trusts for people to be able to plan for their children.

Ms. Graham-Hurd has been the Chair of the Akron Bar Association’s Family Law Committee and Chair of the Ohio State Bar Association Family Law Committee. She was appointed to serve on an Ohio Supreme Court Committee on Children, Families and the Courts. She has assisted the OSBA numerous times in writing laws and rules for consideration by the Ohio Legislature and Ohio Supreme Court and is also a member of a committee that writes the test for lawyers to become certified specialists on Family Relations.

Ms. Graham-Hurd frequently provides lectures and continuing education seminars for other attorneys in Family Law matters and has written a chapter on Government Pensions in the most prominent Ohio Family Law treatise for lawyers. Melissa has a certificate in General and Family Mediation and has served children in family law cases as Guardian ad Litem.

attorneys.name: Anthony W. Greco Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Dublin, OH
attorneys.bio:
Anthony Greco Jr's practice primarily focuses on family law, including divorce, dissolution, custody, post-decree modification, and child support.

Anthony has spent significant time working on cases with complex financials, significant assets, and intense conflict. As a result, Anthony finds that success in the complex world of family law is best achieved through a detail-oriented approach that takes into consideration the long-term effect of each and every move.

Anthony has been working closely with his father, Tony Greco , since 2013. Anthony began his career as a clerk, but has spent years learning the various ins and outs of family law from a team of highly skilled and experienced attorneys. From the start of his career in law, Anthony has been taught effective strategies and methods, allowing him to tackle the complicated realities that our clients must often deal with.

Anthony Greco Jr knows that domestic cases are more than a fight over who gets certain property. attorneys.name: Anthony Greco
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Dublin, OH
attorneys.bio:
Anthony Greco, known as Tony Greco to many, has successfully provided representation to hundreds in the Central Ohio area for over 26 years. During this time, Tony has represented clients in all areas of family law throughout the state of Ohio. Over the years, he has focused his practice on high-asset divorce and high-conflict child custody matters, with additional experience in the developing field of grandparent custody. Further, Anthony Greco has successfully represented clients in cases in numerous Courts of Appeals throughout Ohio, ensuring his clients obtain the result that they deserve.

In addition to his domestic and family law experience, Anthony Greco has provided representation to a wide range of clients in business and real estate settings as well. This representation has ranged from general civil litigation and the drafting of various contracts, to disputes regarding professional practices and independently owned farms. Further, Tony Greco has extensive experience representing physicians, dentists, and numerous other medical professionals in their disputes, be it personal or business related. His experience in these additional areas of law provide clients with knowledge and experience that is unique and advantageous when fighting for the best outcome in their cases.

Anthony Greco was born in Seattle, Washington, but grew up in the Youngstown, Ohio area. During his time in Youngstown, Tony attended and played football at John F. Kennedy High School, before continuing on to attend Youngstown State University. After graduating from YSU with a bachelor's in political science and criminology in 1990, Tony moved to Columbus, Ohio to attend Capital University Law School. Upon completion of his Juris Doctor, he began his lengthy career as an attorney, eventually becoming a partner at a prior firm before deciding to start his own. In the following years, the Law Office of Anthony Greco has grown from a single-member firm to one of the largest independent family law firms in Central Ohio.

Outside of his life as an attorney, Tony enjoys spending as much time as possible with his wife, two sons, and the rest of his extended family. Currently, Anthony Greco currently lives in Dublin, Ohio with his wife, youngest son, several cats, and a very energetic Chihuahua.

attorneys.name: Caryn Markowitz Groedel
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Cleveland, OH
attorneys.bio:
Caryn Markowitz Groedel received her Bachelors of Arts degree from George Washington University and her Juris Doctorate from George Mason University. Caryn is a certified specialist in employment and labor law.

Throughout her career, Caryn has been recognized for her accomplishments, including recognition by Cleveland Magazine in 2009 as one of Cleveland's Top 50 Lawyers and as one of Cleveland's Top 25 Women Lawyers. She was recognized as a "Super Lawyer" by Ohio Super Lawyer Magazine in 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, and 2013, and in February 2008 was recognized as one of Ohio's Top Employment Lawyers by Corporate Counsel magazine.

Caryn's major accomplishments include a $2.1M verdict in a gender/pregnancy discrimination/sexual harassment case; a $1.3M verdict in an age discrimination and retaliation case; and an $800,000 verdict in a reverse sexual harassment case.

She is a founding member of the Cleveland Employment Lawyers Inns of Court, and she is a long-term member of the National Employment Lawyers Association, the Ohio Employment Lawyers Association, and the Cleveland Employment Lawyers Association. Caryn has been featured in local and national media, is a frequent speaker on employment-related issues, and is licensed to practice law in Ohio, Pennsylvania, Washington, D.C., and Maryland.

attorneys.name: Todd E. Gurney
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice/Wrongful Death Lawyers in Cleveland, OH
attorneys.bio:
Todd Gurney joined the firm in 2007. His practice is narrowly focused on cases of medical negligence and wrongful death. Mr. Gurney helps people (and their families) fight for justice and fair compensation when they have been harmed by a medical mistake. Mr. Gurney remains directly involved in every case that he handles, and his clients know that they can reach him directly - day or night - whenever they need to.

Over the years, Mr. Gurney has become familiar with all types of medical injuries - e.g., birth injuries, brain injuries, vascular injuries, broken bones, etc. Mr. Gurney's ability to understand and simplify complicated and complex medical and legal issues has made him an invaluable asset to the firm, but it is his unwavering dedication to help his clients that truly sets him apart from other attorneys.

Mr. Gurney has successfully handled cases across the State of Ohio - from file to trial, and even on appeal - and has gained significant experience in all aspects of civil litigation.

Mr. Gurney is a native Clevelander and an avid sports fan. He enjoys playing golf, basketball, and tennis, and spending time with his wife and two children.

attorneys.name: Hanna B. Haddad
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in West Chester, OH
attorneys.bio:
Hanna grew up watching law movies with her dad. They enjoyed watching Perry Mason, Matlock, and L.A Law. He would tell everyone he knew that his daughter was going to be a lawyer. As early as age 12, that was her aspiration. Hanna wanted to fulfill her dad's wish and of course her own.

Hanna is a proud graduate of Princeton High School and the University of Cincinnati. In 2002, she graduated from the Salmon P. Chase College of Law with a Juris Doctorate. She was commissioned by the Ohio Supreme Court on May 9, 2003.

Prior to joining Lampe Law, Hanna was a sole practitioner from 2003 until March 2017. As a sole practitioner, she practiced in many areas of the law but found that family law was the area she was most passionate about.

During Hanna's time as a sole practitioner, she served as the Executive Director and Contract Attorney for the Butler County Bar Association. In this capacity, she developed invaluable relationships with many colleagues throughout Butler County. Hanna serves as First Vice-President on the 2024-2025 Butler County Bar Association Board.

Of all her roles, Hanna is most proud of being a mother to two sons and one daughter. She is strongly devoted to her family and she has dedicated her professional career to supporting other families as they address issues that arise through family law matters.

attorneys.name: Michael Halberstam
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Rights Lawyers in Cleveland, OH
attorneys.bio:
Michael Halberstam’s experience includes civil rights; employment and whistleblower litigation; political law; voting rights; corporate, civil, and securities litigation; and corporate compliance.

He has litigated in federal district court and in bankruptcy court, conducted corporate internal investigations, managed large-scale electronic discovery, participated in large-scale billion-dollar multi-district litigation, and served as a legal expert on provisions of U.S. federal civil procedure in a number of foreign securities class actions.

After graduating from Stanford Law School, where he was an articles editor on the Stanford Law Review, Michael clerked for Tom Griesa, the former Chief Judge of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York.

He then joined the litigation department of Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton, and Garrison as an associate in New York City.

After practicing for several years, Michael became a fellow at Columbia Law School’s Center for Law and Economic Studies, and then Associate Professor of Law at SUNY Buffalo Law School, where he also was the Director of the Center for Law and Democracy.

Michael is the author of a book and numerous articles, including articles in the Election Law Journal, the Emory Law Journal, the Northwestern Law Review, the Connecticut Law Review, the Seattle Law Review, and Law and Social Inquiry. He has edited two volumes of the Election Law Journal, one on redistricting, the other on the intersection of campaign finance and lobbying regulations. Michael sits on the editorial board of the Election Law Journal.

Michael also earned a Ph.D. in Philosophy from Yale University.

He is admitted to practice law in Ohio and New York.

attorneys.name: Richard O. Hamilton Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Law and Litigation Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Rick is a partner and shareholder at Robbins, Kelly, Patterson & Tucker. He practices in the areas of construction and business law, assisting individuals and businesses with construction issues and commercial disputes ranging from small collection matters to large multi-party complex litigation and arbitration cases. Rick is licensed to practice law in the Ohio and Kentucky state and federal courts. Rick has been with the firm since spring 2008.

Rick offers Construction Arbitration & Mediation Services, and has developed rules for parties interested in private alternative dispute resolution services. He is also a Qualified Neutral for American Arbitration Association as a mediator and an arbitrator since 2011. Rick has presided over 60 arbitrations and a multitude of mediations, involving straight forward disputes as well as complex, multiparty and panel required arbitrations.

Rick has 10 years prior experience as designer and construction manager for residential and light commercial/retail projects. In his law practice, he has extensive construction industry experience representing contractors, sub-contractors, suppliers, architects, and owners on residential, commercial, and public projects, in litigation, arbitration, and mediation. He assists clients with the prosecution and defense of claims, including breaches of contract, failure to perform in a workman-like-manner, Prompt Pay Act violations, enforcement of lien rights (private and public), performance and payment bond claims, Ohio EPA claims, Consumer Sales Practices Act violations, fraud, breaches of fiduciary duties, and various other civil claims, including those involving homeowner/condominium owner disputes.

Rick represents clients in intra-company owner/shareholder disputes and maintains a general business counseling practice and a business litigation practice. He counsels clients on construction and service contracts and on lease and financing agreements for personal and real property. He advises clients on credit and collection matters, including credit applications, terms of credit, collection actions, and FDCPA issues. Rick also advises clients on issues arising from their homeowners’ or condominium owners’ associations.

Rick approaches representation with a business mindset, taking into consideration budgetary constraints, goals, and practical outcomes. He believes in diligence and perseverance in reaching client goals.

Rick enjoys travel, scuba diving, hiking, visual arts and movies with his family.

attorneys.name: Erinn McKee Hannigan
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Erinn McKee Hannigan is an Honors College graduate of Ball State University and received her law degree from Loyola University Chicago School of Law in 2002. She earned a Certificate of Childlaw from Loyola by centering her legal studies in the areas of child and family law. She was admitted to the North Carolina bar in 2002 and the Ohio bar in 2006.

Erinn works hard to help guide her clients towards their new normal. She understands that navigating family law issues can be very difficult. She works with her clients to advise them towards an outcome that is both equitable and reasonable.

Erinn is a bit unique in that she chose to attend law school for the sole purpose of becoming a domestic relations attorney. She has a limited scope practice dedicated to all issues arising in a domestic relations case. In January of 2018 after almost 20 years as a litigator; Erinn left litigation behind and works exclusively as a Peacemaker; assisting clients with their family law matters through out of court settlement processes including mediation, collaboration and standard negotiation. She still works within the court system as an attorney for children, a Guardian ad Litem and as a court appointed Parenting Coordinator. Erinn was trained in family law arbitration in North Carolina in 2004; collaborative practice in 2008; domestic relations mediation in 2011; GAL in 2018 and Parenting Coordination in 2018.

Erinn served as the co-chair of the Cincinnati Academy of Collaborative Professionals previously. Erinn is an educator as a part of the Ohio Supreme Court Faculty for Guardians ad Litem and as a member of the Institute for Family Conflict Resolution as a trainer for introductory and advanced education for collaborative professionals across the United States and beyond.

Erinn is a member of the Domestic Relations Section of the Cincinnati Bar Association, the Ohio Bar Association, the North Carolina Bar Association, the Association of Family and Conciliatory Courts and the International Association of Collaborative Professionals. Erinn is consistently named as a Superlawyer in Ohio since 2007, was named as one of the Top 25 Women Lawyers in Cincinnati in 2016 and 2019 - 2022, Top 50 Superlawyers in Cincinnati in 2019 - 2022 and Top 50 Women Lawyers in Ohio in 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2022.

attorneys.name: Kimberly E. Harrison
attorneys.practice_type: Business Immigration (H1-B's and H20-B's) Lawyers in Columbus, OH
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Kimberly Harrison-Donaldson was a partner and co-founder of Harrison Alo, Attorneys at Law, and is now the founder of Harrison-Donaldson, Attorney at Law. Kimberly is licensed to practice law in the state of Ohio, where she has been a member of the bar since November 2003. Kimberly holds both a Juris Doctorate degree from The Ohio State University's Moritz College of Law and a Master of Business Administration degree from OSU's Fisher College of Business with a major in Finance and a minor in Real Estate Finance. As an undergraduate at Valparaiso University, Kimberly earned her Bachelor of Science degree, cum laude, majoring in Business Management with minors in International Business and Global Studies, as well as Theology.

Over the years, Kimberly has helped hundreds of individuals obtain employment-based visas, family-based visas, green cards, and citizenship. She has represented clients before the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services, the U.S. Department of Labor, Immigration and Customs Enforcement, and the Board of Immigration Appeals. Through her expertise with a diverse range of clients and cases, Kimberly has developed a strong reputation in the legal community as an attorney who is extremely competent, highly-specialized, professional, and personable. In 2007, she was named a Rising Star in the field of immigration by Ohio Super Lawyers Magazine. The Daily Reporter newspaper and other publications have quoted Kimberly as an authority on immigration law issues, and she has been a speaker at several immigration law seminars, roundtables, and question and answer sessions.

At SheaHartman LLP, we are very proud of the accomplishments of Greg Hartmann. In 1997, he graduated with honors from Pepperdine University Law School. He completed his undergraduate studies at the prestigious Washington and Lee University in Lexington, Virginia. In 1999, Mr. Hartmann began his career as a Hamilton County prosecutor where he handled hundreds of criminal trials, the majority of which involved felony crimes. His record as a prosecutor is outstanding. Following four years of this aggressive trial practice, he became the clerk of the Hamilton County courts. attorneys.bio:
William Hatt is an Associate at Cavitch, focusing on litigation. He brings a strong academic and practical background to the firm, having recently earned his Juris Doctor from the University of Akron School of Law where he was a Dean’s Honors List recipient every semester.

During law school, William distinguished himself through a variety of roles and activities. He was a two-year member of both the Akron Law Trial Team and the Moot Court Honor Society. His achievements on the Trial Team include a 2nd Place finish in the 2023 OAG Mock Trial Competition and being a Regional Finalist in the 2024 AAJ STAC. As a member of the Moot Court team, he competed in the Jessup International Moot Court Competition in both 2024 and 2025.

William also served as an Academic Success Program Fellow for Civil Procedure and co-founded the International Law Society at the University of Akron. He was a Student Coordinator for the Akron Law Expungement Clinic, assisting with client management and court filings. His academic excellence was recognized with CALI Awards for achieving the highest grades in Law, Economic Development, and International Trade, and Alternative Dispute Resolution.

William is a native English speaker with conversational proficiency in Spanish. His personal interests include tennis, visiting museums, and camping.

Spending a few minutes on the telephone with me may provide you with the answers you are looking for and calm your anxieties.

Like all the attorneys at Slater and Zurz LLP, I am focused on getting results for my clients while providing them with unparalleled service. attorneys.name: Robert F. Healey Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
My name is Robert Healey. My journey into the legal field started in law enforcement as a police explorer in high school for a few years. I was trained at Deer Park Police Department and later at Blue Ash Police Department. After graduating high school at St. Xavier in 1992 I went off to get a bachelor’s degree from Xavier University. Ultimately my Juris Doctorate came from The University of Dayton School of Law. My background in law enforcement really helped me understand how police officers think and react to different situations and has been invaluable in cross examining officers on the stand. I graduated at the top of my class for class participation during NHTSA DWI Detection and Standardized Field Sobriety Testing (SFST), completed the NHTSA Advanced Roadside Impaired Driving Enforcement (ARIDE) Course, have participated in the Cincinnati Police Academy mock motion to suppress on an OVI case, taught an OVI refresher course at Butler Tech to police officers, presented at a continuing education seminar for other Ohio lawyers at the Ohio Criminal Defense Lawyers Association Advanced OVI Seminar, spoken on Medical Marijuana Law at the Lawyers Club of Cincinnati, testified as a OVI expert witness in an arbitration case involving a Dayton Police Officer, had judges grant motions to suppress evidence, won multiple jury trials including a not guilty verdict from a jury on a felony fourth degree 6th OVI offense in 20 years, was named a Rising Star from Super Lawyers 2014-2018, named to the Top 40 Under 40 list for National Trial Lawyers, and been awarded the Avvo.com Client’s Choice Award ten years in a row! A substantial part of my practice has involved drunk driving or under the influence cases historically called DUI and now called OVI in Ohio. I have fought OVI cases in the following counties in Ohio: Hamilton, Clermont, Butler, Warren, Champaign, Brown, Highland, Clinton, Greene, Montgomery, Preble, Clark, Darke, Miami, Shelby, Mercer, and Allen. I also defend criminal and traffic cases in Boone, Kenton, Campbell, and Gallatin Counties in District and Circuit Courts in Kentucky.

I have defended clients charged with all manner of Misdemeanors, Felonies, Traffic Violations, Driver’s License Problems, etc. I have handled cases with the following: DUI, OVI, Felony OVI, Aggravated Vehicular Assault/Homicide, Vehicular Homicide, Leaving the Scene of an Accident, Speeding, Marked Lanes, Bank Robbery, Theft, Fraud, Forgery, Counterfeiting, Assault, Felonious Assault, Kidnapping, Child Endangering, Underage Sale, Consumption and Possession, Drug Possession, Aggravated Drug Possession, Drug Paraphernalia, Cultivation of Marijuana, Drug Trafficking, Theft of Dangerous Drugs, Deception of Obtain Drugs, Aggravated Menacing, Menacing by Stalking, Probation Violations, Unlawful Sexual Conduct with a Minor, Gross Sexual Imposition, Public Indecency, Solicitation, Prostitution, Arson, Criminal Damaging, Robbery, Burglary, Trespassing, Disorderly Conduct, Telephone Communications Harassment, Making False Alarms, Improper Handling of a Firearm in a Motor Vehicle, Weapons Under Disability, Tampering with Evidence, Falsification, Resisting Arrest, Obstruction of Official Business, Failure to Comply with a Police Order or Signal, Carrying a Concealed Weapon, Weapons while Intoxicated, Relief from Weapons Disability, Possession of Criminal Tools, Illegal Processing of Drug Documents, and other types of criminal charges.I have defended criminal and traffic cases that resulted in reduced charges, dismissals, and amendments. Courts have made findings in my clients’ cases of no probable cause for arrest, suppression of evidence granted, motions to suppress field sobriety tests and breath tests granted, granted motions to exclude evidence, and I have had judges and juries find clients not guilty.

attorneys.name: J. Jeffrey Heck
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Mansfield, OH
attorneys.bio:
Jeff Heck, "Mansfield's Injury Lawyer," has extensive legal experience handling all types of injury and wrongful death cases and insurance claims of many kinds. He also handles civil commercial litigation and labor and employment matters representing both employers and employees. He is a court-trained Mediator and has also served as an appointed Mediator for the Richland County Court of Common Pleas, as well as a private Mediator and Arbitrator selected jointly by other attorneys in numerous other cases and disputes.

Jeff has his roots in North Central Ohio. He grew up in the Mansfield area and graduated from Malabar High School. He is also a graduate of The Ohio State University where he was a 4 year member and a Squad Leader of The Ohio State University Marching Band. He graduated with Honors from The University of Florida College of Law. He has over 30 years of extensive courtroom and other legal experience and is admitted to practice law in the courts of both Ohio and Florida, including various federal district and appellate courts.

Jeff began his legal career with a very large Florida law firm. He then returned to Mansfield in the late 1980's to help people in his hometown and in the region where he grew up. He is a strong believer in the idea of "giving back" to the community. He believes strongly in his community and, in addition to his law practice, has put his time and energy behind many non-profit organizations to try to improve it. He is presently the Chairman of the Board of 33 Forever, Inc., a mental health nonprofit, and is a Board Member and Treasurer of the Ohio Suicide Prevention Foundation. In 2001, he was elected to the Lexington Local Schools Board of Education where he served 4 elected terms as a Board member, including Board Vice President for several of those years. He is also the Past Board Chairman and Board Member of Renaissance Performing Arts Association and the Rehabilitation Services of North Central Ohio. He has served as President of the University Club of Mansfield and the University Club Educational Foundation and as a Trustee and Secretary of the Richland County Foundation, among many others.

Jeff also believes that giving back to the legal profession is important. His service has included several terms as the Secretary of the Richland County Bar Association and as the Litigation Chair of its Certified Grievance Committee. He was elected and re-elected numerous times by his peers as a 22 year member of the Ohio State Bar Association's Council of Delegates. In 2017, he was honored as a Fellow of the Ohio State Bar Foundation, the charitable arm of the Ohio State Bar Association. He has also served on numerous OSBA committees and task forces. Currently he is a member of and a District representative for the Ohio Association for Justice — the only statewide organization of lawyers dedicated to protecting and fighting for the rights of ordinary citizens in Ohio’s civil justice system. He also previously served on the Executive Committee of the Ohio Association of Civil Trial Attorneys and is currently a member of the Ohio State Bar Association, Richland County Bar Association and the Florida Bar.

Jeff and his wife, Donna (Office Manager/CFO of Heck & Stiffler), make their home in the Mansfield area. They have 6 adult children and 9 grandchildren.

attorneys.name: John L. Heilbrun
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of John Heilbrun
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce/Dissolution Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
John Heilbrun has been serving clients throughout the Greater Cincinnati area, including in Hamilton, Clermont and Warren Counties, for over 40 years. Although in the past, John has represented clients who have needed his services in a variety of different areas of law, including family law matters, over the past twenty plus years, his practice has been focused primarily on Family Relations Law. John assists people who are facing the end of their marriage, and who are dealing with the issues that arise when a marriage is ending, including the division of assets, (real estate, financial accounts and retirement benefits), as well as spousal support/alimony and the allocation of parental rights and responsibilities involving minor children. Although John has extensive experience litigating cases in Court, over the years he has learned that the best way for his clients to have all of these issues resolved, is through a process whereby the client and her/his spouse are to resolve all of these issues by agreement with the assistance of their attorneys, and sometimes other appropriate professionals. One of these processes, that John strongly supports, is the Collaborative Process. John has been representing clients in the Collaborative Process for over 25 years.

John is a native of Cincinnati, Ohio, and graduated from Walnut Hills High School. He received his B.A. Degree from the State University of New York at Stony Brook, and graduated from Law School at the University of Cincinnati College of Law. John was awarded his Juris Doctor in 1977, and is admitted to practice before all courts in the State of Ohio as well as the local United States District Court.

John is a member of the Cincinnati Bar Association, the Ohio State Bar Association, the Cincinnati Academy of Collaborative Professionals and the International Association of Collaborative Professionals. For the past several years has been named as a Super Lawyer in Ohio.

Over the years, John has extensive experience working with complex termination of marriage issues, including property division, support matters and parenting issues. In addition to having extensive experience representing clients in the Collaborative Family Law Process, John also has significant experience assisting and representing clients in Mediation and other processes designed to assist and encourage people who are ending their marriage, to work together with their attorneys to try and resolve all such issues by agreement.

John and his Wife, Gwen, have been married for over 40 years and have a daughter, Lauren, who is married and has four children. John spends a significant amount of his off time with his extended family and grandchildren, as well as several longtime friends. For the past 40 years, John’s favorite extracurricular activity has been golf.

If your marriage is ending, or you believe that is a possibility and would like to obtain significant information related to the processes available to terminate your marriage and the issues that will need to be addressed and determined as a result of the ending of your marriage, contact John Heilbrun to obtain such information, help and assistance.

attorneys.name: Eli Heller
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Cuyahoga Falls, OH
attorneys.bio:
Eli Heller has dedicated his professional career to helping individuals.

Eli Heller has dedicated his professional career to helping individuals. Prior to starting law school Eli Received his B.A in English Literature from Messiah College in 2005. After Graduating from College Eli and His wife Joined the U.S. Peace Corps where they served for two years as education volunteers in the Philippines. While there, Eli and His wife built two libraries, successfully drafted grants securing funding for computer labs for two local schools and He helped to create sustainable recycling program in the local town. After successfully completing his Peace Corps service, Eli and his wife moved on to teach English in Seoul South Korea for two years.

After returning to the United States, Eli Attended the University of Akron School of Law. During law School, Eli tutored first year law students in civil procedures, was a member of the nationally ranked Akron Trial Team, and he was elected Student bar Association President.

After Graduating Law school Eli went on to work at the Portage County Public Defender’s office. It was there that he continued to hone his skills appearing in court conducting trials and various hearings. Eli continued to aid underserved communities as a Legal Defender for summit county, while at the same time running his own private practice specializing in criminal defense.

Currently at Hoover Kacyon, Eli is a trial lawyer in criminal and traffic matters who also handles civil protection order hearings. Eli is experienced in negotiating desirable plea deals and has successfully worked with prosecutors throughout northeast Ohio to reach mutually beneficial results without going to trial. In addition, Eli has experience as lead attorney on more than a dozen jury trials and he has successfully received not guilty verdicts for clients in complicated situations. Eli has handled advanced felony cases for felonious assaults, Domestic Violence, trafficking in narcotics and various weapons charges. Eli regularly practices in Municipal Courts including, Stow, Akron, Kent, Ravenna and many more. Eli represents clients on cases ranging from simple traffic offenses all the way to complex OVI charges, and domestic violence matters.

Most recently in the summer of 2023 Eli Heller became a graduate of the 3 week intensive training program of the Trial lawyers College. The Trial Lawyers College is dedicated to training and educating lawyers and judges who are committed to the jury system and to representing and obtaining justice for individuals and to protecting the rights of such people from corporate and government oppression. Eli is one of only 5 other attorneys practicing criminal law in Summit and Portage counties to have completed this rigorous program.

When Eli is not practicing Law, you can find him enjoying time with his family or hiking one of the many amazing Metro Park trails.

After returning to the United States, Eli Attended the University of Akron School of Law. During law School, Eli tutored first year law students in civil procedures, was a member of the nationally ranked Akron Trial Team, and he was elected Student bar Association President.

After Graduating Law school Eli went on to work at the Portage County Public Defender’s office. It was there that he continued to hone his skills appearing in court conducting trials and various hearings. Eli continued to aid underserved communities as a Legal Defender for summit county, while at the same time running his own private practice specializing in criminal defense.

Currently at Hoover Kacyon, Eli is a trial lawyer in criminal and traffic matters who also handles civil protection order hearings. Eli is experienced in negotiating desirable plea deals and has successfully worked with prosecutors throughout northeast Ohio to reach mutually beneficial results without going to trial. In addition, Eli has experience as lead attorney on more than a dozen jury trials and he has successfully received not guilty verdicts for clients in complicated situations. Eli has handled advanced felony cases for felonious assaults, Domestic Violence, trafficking in narcotics and various weapons charges. Eli regularly practices in Municipal Courts including, Stow, Akron, Kent, Ravenna and many more. Eli represents clients on cases ranging from simple traffic offenses all the way to complex OVI charges, and domestic violence matters.

Most recently in the summer of 2023 Eli Heller became a graduate of the 3 week intensive training program of the Trial lawyers College. The Trial Lawyers College is dedicated to training and educating lawyers and judges who are committed to the jury system and to representing and obtaining justice for individuals and to protecting the rights of such people from corporate and government oppression. Eli is one of only 5 other attorneys practicing criminal law in Summit and Portage counties to have completed this rigorous program.

When Eli is not practicing Law, you can find him enjoying time with his family or hiking one of the many amazing Metro Park trails.

attorneys.name: Robert L Heller
attorneys.firm_name: Heller, Maas, Moro & Magill Co., LPA
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Disability (SSDI) Lawyers in Youngstown, OH
attorneys.bio:
Robert L. Heller has devoted his entire multi-decades legal career to helping disabled people in the Mahoning Valley receive needed benefits.

A native of Warren, Atty. Heller knew from an early age that he wanted to be a lawyer. His uncle, Robert N. Heller, was a well-known attorney in the area-and a role model for his nephew.

Atty. Heller graduated from Warren G. Harding High School in Warren and then went on to Miami University of Ohio, where he earned a B.A. degree in 1975. He spent a year in a master's program studying public administration at American University in Washington, D.C., before enrolling at the University of Toledo College of Law.

While in law school, Atty. Heller took part in a legal clinic where he handled Social Security Disability and Supplemental Security Income cases on behalf of clients with mental health issues. That experience had a profound impact on him and convinced him that he wanted to concentrate his legal career on helping people receive Social Security disability benefits.

After receiving his J.D. in 1981, Heller joined a firm where he immediately focused his practice on Social Security disability and workers' compensation cases. He and a colleague at that firm, Steven Maas, left after two years to launch the firm that would become Heller, Maas, Moro & Magill.

The creation of the firm coincided with the beginning of the decline of the steel industry in the Mahoning Valley, and the services the firm provided to workers who lost their jobs and needed help were critical to thousands of families.

Heller handles every aspect of Social Security disability cases, from initial intake to resolution. Oftentimes, these cases can linger for long periods of time-a situation made worse by declining services at local Social Security offices. Knowing how frustrating the process can be, Robert makes it a point to be as caring as possible to his clients.

In describing the skills that he has found to be necessary for being a good SSDI/SSI lawyer, he says, "You have to be honest, you have to be a good listener, you have to be compassionate. You have to be willing to help people and not make any value judgments about them."

He also pledges to be as responsive as possible when his clients have questions. In many situations, they need short-term help to address medical issues or other problems, and the firm is able to provide information about where they can go for assistance.

"If you call today and we can't back to you before we close, we'll get back to you within 24 hours," he says.

Heller's commitment to working people in the Mahoning Valley has extended beyond his own legal practice. He has served on the boards of the Hillside Rehabilitation Hospital in Howland and the Fairhaven School and Workshop, which provides educational services for children and adults with developmental disabilities.

He is a member of the National Organization of Social Security Claimants Representatives (NOSSCR) and the Trumbull County Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Christina Strasel Helmer
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Christina has been an attorney, licensed in the State of Ohio, since 2010 after graduating summa cum laude from University of Cincinnati in 2006 and magna cum laude from Northern Kentucky University Chase, College of Law in 2009.

Christina’s tenacious representation of clients began at a nonprofit child advocacy agency representing children navigating the legal system due to parental abuse and neglect. She learned early in her career to be a calm, clear, and understanding advisor for her clients facing difficult and stressful situations, making sure that each client understands the next steps in the legal process. Christina works hard to help clients find solutions outside of the courtroom through negotiation and mediation but is an experienced litigator when that is the next step a client’s matter requires.

Christina represents clients in all areas of family law including divorce, dissolution, child custody, domestic violence civil protection orders, post decree matters, spousal support, child support, juvenile matters, and adoption.

Christina is also an experienced criminal defense attorney and represents clients in felony, misdemeanor, and traffic-related matters. Christina worked as an assistant prosecutor prior to entering private practice and brings her courtroom experience to carefully evaluate a client’s case and prepare the best possible defense.

Christina primarily focuses her practice in Hamilton, Clermont, Warren, Brown, and Adams Counties.

attorneys.name: Laura Helmbrecht
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Columbus, OH
attorneys.bio:
Located in downtown Columbus, Ohio, Laura Helmbrecht, Attorney at Law, is a boutique law firm dedicated to serving the needs of people throughout the city and surrounding counties in the areas of family law. Led by attorney Laura Helmbrecht, we combine professional representation with personal service to meet the needs of our clients.

Our law firm provides strong and strategic defense for clients facing private or commercial license suspensions. In the area of family law, we pursue practical and creative solutions for divorce, child custody, visitation rights, domestic disputes, uncontested divorces (dissolution), and post-decree modifications. Our attorney is also certified in Collaborative Law and serves as a mediator, helping clients resolve family law matters through cooperative and effective dispute resolution.

Laura is a member of the Ohio State Bar Association, Family Law Committee. She is working on obtaining certification to be a Family Law Mediator in the state of Florida and volunteers with the American Cancer Society.

At our law firm, we believe that communication and hard work are the keys to a successful partnership with our clients. We strive for excellence in our practice, working diligently to solve our clients' problems through personal consultation, we offer both in person and virtual consultations. We have a reputation in our local community for the professionalism, dedication and personalized attention we offer our clients.

If you have a legal need in central Ohio, Laura Helmbrecht, Attorney at Law, is ready to advocate for you.

attorneys.name: Doug R. Henry
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Cleveland, OH
attorneys.bio:
Doug Henry was admitted to practice law in 2001 and he has been practicing family law almost exclusively for the past sixteen years. Doug worked in the Office of the Counsel to the Governor in Albany, New York while he attended law school at Albany Law School.

Upon graduation, he worked for a large law firm in New York City until moving to Cleveland in 2007, to be closer to family. In order to attend to his clients’ family law issues, Doug has appeared in domestic relations, juvenile, probate, general division, criminal, and municipal courts across Ohio. Currently, Doug is the Chair of the Lorain County Bar Association Domestic Relations Section and a member of the Lorain County Bar Association Executive Board.

Doug has an interest in the affect familial discord and litigation have on generational wealth, children and society. In the past, Doug has served as a board member for Voices for Children and the Cuyahoga County Juvenile Court Guardian ad Litem Project. Doug is an Ohio certified Divorce Mediator and Parenting Coordinator and served as a Guardian ad Litem for over ten years. Doug is also trained as a Collaborative Law practitioner.

Doug has published articles on family law and guardianship in the Domestic Relations Journal of Ohio and the Lorain County Legal Times. Doug is a member of various professional associations including the American Bar Association Artificial Reproduction Technology Committee.

Outside of work Doug enjoys spending time with his family outdoors. Doug spends an exorbitant amount of his leisure time watching Rugby, a sport that he played in college, law school and beyond. Having caused much damage to his body in his youth, he now enjoys low impact sports such as rock climbing and fly-fishing.

attorneys.name: Franklin J. Hickman
attorneys.firm_name: Hickman Lowder Lidrbauch & Welch Co., L.P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Special Education Lawyers in Independence, OH
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Franklin J. Hickman has focused his career on legal issues affecting persons with mental disabilities since his graduation from the University of Pennsylvania School of Law in 1973, where he received the Wiley C. Rutledge Memorial Award. Frank's first major case established the right of indigent persons in Ohio to have legal counsel provided at public expense at their civil commitment proceedings.

During his nine years as a member of the Law Reform Unit of the Legal Aid Society of Cleveland, Frank brought numerous successful class actions establishing and defining the treatment rights of patients in psychiatric hospitals and state institutions for persons with developmental disabilities, and of prison inmates with psychiatric problems. He was founder and director of the Cleveland Bar advocacy project which sponsored education programs for the private bar and conducted extensive advocacy work in the establishment of group homes.

Since going into private practice in 1981, Frank has focused his practice on families with members who are mentally and/or physically impaired as well as the agencies and county boards throughout the state which provide services to persons with mental illness or developmental disabilities or substance abuse problems.

Frank has represented families cases since 1975 in negotiations, mediations, due process proceedings and cases in all courts, including the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit. He spends a major part of his practice on cases under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA), which defines and protects rights of children. He was named Lawyer of the Year for education work in 2018 and 2023.

He has been on the faculty of the medical (since 1978), and law (from 1988 to 2016) schools at Case Western Reserve University teaching law and psychiatry. For the past 50 years, Frank has presented over 3,000 local, regional, and national seminars and workshops on legal issues relating to mental disability. Frank often speaks on topics related to Benefits.

attorneys.name: Layne Hilton Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Products Liability Lawyers in Columbus, OH
attorneys.bio:
Layne became a lawyer for one simple reason: to advocate for those who could not advocate for themselves. Throughout her career, she has sought to do just that – from representing class consumer cases involving small amounts of money, to representing people who suffer from debilitating and life-threatening injuries as a product of corporate greed.

This desire to advocate for others has led Layne to represent a wide swath of clients – from insurance companies and managed care organizations; to consumers and average people who have been harmed by defective products. Layne has pursued cases that involve antitrust violations, the Racketeering Influence and Corrupt Organizations (“RICO”) Act, and various state law claims. She takes tremendous pride in developing of new and novel legal approaches to resolve the issues and problems that plague her clients. Layne is also a tireless litigator. During the Coronavirus Pandemic, Layne took weeks of depositions of foreign nationals located in China and India over zoom. These depositions frequently did not begin until dinnertime and lasted into overnight hours.

Layne is currently representing clients in the Paraquat, and Uber Sexual Assault multi-district litigation. She also serves on the Plaintiffs’ Steering Committee of the In re Valsartan, Losartan, and Irbesartan Products Liability Litigation. As part of that litigation, she serves as the co-chair of the Consumer Class Action committee and is a member of the discovery committee. In addition to her products liability work, Layne also has significant experience representing clients in class action cases and is currently representing several classes of Plaintiffs in data breach lawsuits in both Louisiana and throughout the country.

Layne attended Mount Holyoke College and graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree in British Literature. She later went on to obtain her law degree from Emory University School of Law.

Layne is a member of the Louisiana Bar Association, New Orleans Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, and the Louisiana Association for Justice. As part of the American Association of Justice, Layne has been appointed to serve on the Law School Committee, the International Law Committee, and the Diversity and Inclusion Committee. Layne is a coordinator for the American Association of Justice’s Student Trial Advocacy Competition.

Layne is also an active participant in her community. She is involved in her local neighborhood association and assists high school students in their college application process. In her free time, she enjoys reading, conducting genealogical research, and attending the many music and arts festivals New Orleans offers throughout the year.

attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Services Lawyers in Cincinnati, OH
attorneys.bio:
Chuck Hinegardner’s practice areas include civil litigation and domestic relations. As a litigator, Chuck has tried and handled numerous types of cases including contract and coverage disputes, motor vehicle personal injury, premises liability, wrongful death, trade secrets, non-compete agreements, construction claims and product liability. He takes a proactive approach to handling litigation matters, working closely with clients to develop a strategy for reaching the desired outcome.

Chuck has handled numerous divorce and dissolution matters. He has been appointed Guardian Ad Litem by courts in dependency and neglect matters. He is very involved with counseling his clients, discussing likely results and ensuring that the client’s interests are protected and represented.

Recent Results:

In an involved and lengthy construction matter, Chuck and his client obtained a verdict of $597,066.27, which included $100,000 of punitive damages for a fraud claim.

In a recent personal injury jury trial, Chuck’s client was awarded $129,676.61.

He and his client received a very favorable decision from a Family Law Court after an emotional two day custody trial.

He and his client received a favorable decision from a Family Law Court in a matter involving tracing pre-marital money through two homes. His client was able to retain that pre-marital money in the current marital residence which she was also granted exclusive use of.

Chuck obtained a successful decision from the Court of Appeals defending a client in a trip and fall personal injury matter.

He also received a dismissal for the same client on statute of limitations grounds in another case.

Personal

Currently lives in Ft. Thomas, Kentucky with his wife and four children.

Coaches youth basketball, soccer, flag football, baseball and softball.

attorneys.name: Patrick J. Hoban
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Issues Lawyers in Cleveland, OH
attorneys.bio:
Patrick J. Hoban joined Zashin and Rich Co., L.P.A. in 2008. Pat's practice is focused on public and private sector labor relations and employment issues. He represents municipal clients in collective bargaining, labor arbitrations, unfair labor practice proceedings and provides day-to day counsel to public employers on matters including contract administration, unemployment, work rules, compliance with state and federal employment regulations and civil service issues. Pat has also represented and advised large national and local private sector employers on a variety of issues arising under the National Labor Relations Act and federal and state employment laws and in collective bargaining and labor arbitration matters. He has successfully represented clients before the Ohio State Employment Relations Board, the National Labor Relations Board, in federal and state courts, and before a variety of federal and state administrative agencies.

Pat earned his B.A. from Boston College, cum laude. After serving as an officer in the U.S. Navy onboard USS Clark (FFG-11), he worked as a firefighter/paramedic with a municipal fire department and was promoted to the rank of lieutenant. Pat then earned his law degree, summa cum laude, from the University of Akron where he was a member of the law review editorial staff.

Pat is admitted to practice law in the State of Ohio and in the United States District Courts for the Northern and Southern Districts of Ohio. He is a member of the Cleveland and Ohio Bar Associations and is certified as a specialist in labor and employment law by the Ohio State Bar Association.

attorneys.name: Tad Orval Hoover
attorneys.practice_type: Family law Lawyers in Cuyahoga Falls, OH
attorneys.bio:
Is a family law litigator, as well as an experienced trial lawyer in matters of criminal and traffic law, and real estate matters.

Tad knew from a very young age, like others in his family, that he was destined to be an attorney. The son of the Honorable Judge Kim R. Hoover and the grandson of the late Orval R. Hoover, Tad was raised in a family that values tradition and has left a strong imprint on the legal community in northeast Ohio. Because of this, Tad’s lifelong goal was to, alongside his sister, carry on a strong family tradition of excellence in the legal field in the same building his grandfather, father, and aunt and uncles have practiced before him.

Since joining his sister, Corinne Hoover, at Hoover and Associates, LLC in 2011, Tad has focused extensively on Domestic Relations matters. In this role, Tad has counseled clients through high asset divorce cases, domestic custody and visitation matters, out-of-state and foreign custody disputes, and has successfully both brought and defended contempt actions and civil protection orders. Tad has handled both high asset divorce cases from the inception to completion at trial, and has also successfully minimized court involvement for his clients through negotiating advantageous settlements.

Along with developing his family law practice, Tad has also gained considerable experience as a trial lawyer in criminal and traffic matters. Tad is experienced in negotiating desirable plea deals and has successfully worked with prosecutors throughout northeast Ohio to reach mutually beneficial results without going to trial. In addition, Tad is no stranger to jury trials and has successfully received not guilty verdicts for clients in complicated situations. Tad has handled advanced felony cases for felonious assaults, theft, trafficking in narcotics and various weapons charges. Additionally, Tad has become a regular at the Stow Municipal Court, representing clients on matters of OVI charges, traffic offenses, and domestic violence matters. For matters Tad has been unable to have dismissed, he has successfully sealed the record of every client who has applied for record expungement, by ensuring the client presents a thorough and strong case.

Now, at Hoover Kacyon, LLC, Tad, a partner attorney, heads up the firm’s real estate practice group as well, due to his experience in landlord tenant matters and other real estate and property disputes. Tad is very experienced in bringing eviction lawsuits, as well as advising clients how to avoid eviction issues by effectively managing properties and their businesses, so that they have more profit and less expenses for legal matters.
